item.title: Financial inclusion is accelerating — and savings are leading the way
item.description: The World Bank's Global Findex 2025 shows the fastest rise in formal saving in over a decade, driven by mobile phones. Here is what changed, and what it means for teams that measure financial health.

item.title: Five SQL window-function patterns every analyst should keep handy
item.description: Deduplicate records, build running totals, compare periods, compute shares and rank within groups — five copy-ready T-SQL patterns that also run in Microsoft Fabric warehouses.
